# PySSTV test reference

Source: https://github.com/dnet/pysstv at `d998fad154d3e6ad2d73af5add49beec0d2ab59f`, inspected 2026-10-15. MIT license retained verbatim. No upstream runtime code is incorporated. The project generated the test-only Martin M2 color-bar waveform documented in `src/textmodem/fixtures/sstv-m2-reference.json`; waveform generation, analytic conversion and limitations are described in that directory's README.
